Ecommerce Prompt:

Create a production-ready Angular ecommerce application for products,
categories, inventory, customers, orders, cart, checkout, payments, coupons,
and reports.

Use Angular standalone components, Angular Router, Angular Material, Signals,
RxJS, strict TypeScript, JWT authentication, lazy loading, and responsive
accessible UI.

Use mock JSON data initially. Include working search, filtering, sorting,
pagination, cart updates, checkout validation, order creation, and admin CRUD
for products, categories, inventory, and coupons.

Follow the enterprise discovery process. Read this entire prompt first and do
not repeat questions already answered here. Ask only for missing information,
one question at a time. Create the project outside the Orchestrator-Agent
folder, implement the complete application, and run tests, lint, typecheck, and
production build.

Healthcare Prompt:

Create a production-ready Angular healthcare management application for
patients, doctors, appointments, medical records, prescriptions, billing,
insurance, reports, and notifications.

Use Angular standalone components, Angular Router, Angular Material, Signals,
RxJS, strict TypeScript, JWT authentication, role-based access control, lazy
loading, and responsive accessible UI.

Use a REST API with typed DTOs and HttpClient services. Add protected routes for
admins, doctors, staff, and patients. Include appointment booking, patient
search, filtering, validation, loading states, empty states, error handling,
and audit-friendly workflows.

Read the complete prompt before asking questions. Do not repeat any information
already provided. Ask only genuinely missing questions, one at a time. Create
the project outside the Orchestrator-Agent folder and complete implementation
and validation.
---------------------------------
Education Platform Prompt:

Create a production-ready Angular education platform for students, teachers,
courses, lessons, assignments, quizzes, grades, attendance, announcements, and
reports.

Use Angular standalone components, Angular Router, Angular Material, Signals,
RxJS, strict TypeScript, OAuth2 authentication, lazy-loaded feature routes,
and responsive accessible UI.

Use mock JSON data with a service-based data layer. Include dashboards for
students, teachers, and administrators; course enrollment; lesson progress;
quiz submission; grade viewing; search; filtering; sorting; validation; and
role-based navigation.

Read the whole prompt first and reuse all supplied requirements. Do not ask
repeated questions. Ask only for missing project or configuration information,
one question at a time. Create the project outside the Orchestrator-Agent
folder, implement all requested features, and run tests, lint, typecheck, and
production build.

Finance Application Prompt:

Create a production-ready Angular finance management application for accounts,
transactions, invoices, payments, budgets, expenses, customers, approvals,
and financial reports.

Use Angular standalone components, Angular Router, Angular Material, Signals,
RxJS, strict TypeScript, JWT authentication, multi-role RBAC, lazy loading,
and responsive accessible UI.

Use a REST API through typed HttpClient services. Add secure route guards,
authorization-aware navigation, transaction filtering, invoice validation,
approval workflows, dashboard summaries, loading states, empty states, error
states, and audit information.

Parse all requirements in this prompt before asking questions. Do not repeat
answered questions. Ask only for genuinely missing values, one at a time.
Create the project outside the Orchestrator-Agent folder and complete the
implementation and validation workflow.

Inventory and Warehouse Prompt:

Create a production-ready Angular warehouse and inventory application for
products, warehouses, stock levels, suppliers, purchase orders, shipments,
receiving, barcode scanning, transfers, and reports.

Use Angular standalone components, Angular Router, PrimeNG, Signals, RxJS,
strict TypeScript, JWT authentication, lazy loading, and responsive accessible
UI.

Use a REST API with typed DTOs and HttpClient. Include stock search, filters,
sorting, pagination, low-stock alerts, warehouse transfers, receiving
validation, supplier management, loading/error/empty states, and admin-only
operations.

First read the entire prompt and conversation. Treat every explicit feature,
technology, authentication method, and data-source choice as already answered.
Never repeat a question. Ask only the first missing question and proceed to
implementation once requirements are complete.

Portfolio Website Prompt:

Create a production-ready Angular portfolio website for displaying projects,
case studies, skills, experience, testimonials, blog posts, and contact
messages.

Use Angular standalone components, Angular Router, Angular Material, Signals,
strict TypeScript, responsive accessible UI, SEO-friendly metadata, animations
with reduced-motion support, and a typed mock data service.

Include project filtering, project detail routes, contact-form validation,
success and error states, responsive navigation, accessible components, and a
simple admin area for managing projects and posts.

Read the complete request first. Do not ask questions that are already answered.
Ask only for missing information, create the project outside the
Orchestrator-Agent folder, and run lint, tests, typecheck, and production build.

Custom Application Template Prompt:

Create a production-ready Angular application for [describe the domain].

Application features:
- [feature 1]
- [feature 2]
- [feature 3]
- [feature 4]

Use:
- UI framework: [Angular Material / PrimeNG / Tailwind]
- Data source: [Mock JSON / REST API / GraphQL / Database]
- Authentication: [JWT / OAuth2 / RBAC / None]
- State management: [Signals / RxJS / NgRx]
- Project location: [path outside Orchestrator-Agent]

Use Angular standalone components, Angular Router, strict TypeScript, lazy
loading, responsive accessible UI, typed services, and feature-based folders.

Read the complete prompt and conversation before asking questions. Store all
values already provided, including application type, category, data source,
state management, authentication, modules, project name, and project path.
Never ask an already answered question. Ask only the first genuinely missing
value, one question at a time.

After requirements are complete, scaffold the project, implement all requested
routes and features, add loading/error/empty/validation states, and run tests,
lint, typecheck, and production build. Do not stop after installing Angular or
a UI library.
